profile.summary: Side by Side is a nonprofit that supports young people ages 5 to 26 affected by trauma and adversity in the Bay Area, with behavioral and mental health services, school-based early intervention, transitional housing for foster youth, and special education. Its Irene M. Hunt School in San Anselmo is a nonpublic day school for students in kindergarten through 12th grade who need individualized education and therapeutic support.
